physicalNotes: Radius 0.72 +/- 0.029 solar radii from Stalport et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1453 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..86S/abstract): 500,904 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 4975 +/- 68 K from Stalport et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1453 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..86S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
